title: Session handoff 2026-10-28 - renewal to Sonnet; successor entry point
summary: Handoff from the deepseek-flash session, renewed by team-lead (Rev 339) onto Sonnet. Successor next work, in the order the leader gave it: OMARK-102, the DEC-240 CI review follow-ups (refused for a sub-floor model); then filing the plain-english-styles release task, which must not become a release because nothing is currently unreleased; then filing the negentropy-skills release task, which the leader still holds. Read the HANDOFF 2026-10-26 note on OMARK-102 alongside this record.
description: Durable handoff for the session renewal of 2026-10-28. Repository state, the successor queue, and the environment lessons that cost this session time are in the implementation notes. Nothing here is work for the handing-over session: its only write is filing this record.
implementationNotes: HANDOFF 2026-10-28 (renewal to Sonnet; team-lead Rev 339; operator-approved plan 2026-10-28 under DEC-232). Measured at handoff, not recalled: origin/dev e9710bbd5d91b017cb2784c5b7bbc3945034a344, origin/main 1cb49461ad07a9cc34a2109625528730c9c84cb4, so dev is two tracker-only commits ahead of main and rides the next content promotion. Tree clean, nothing In Progress, no open PR. The earlier handoff is the note dated 2026-10-26 on OMARK-102; this record supersedes it. Promoting dev to main is a leader decision and is not done here.

SUCCESSOR NEXT WORK, in the order team-lead gave it. (1) OMARK-102, the DEC-240 CI review follow-ups. dispatch-floor refused it on the deepseek-flash session because its text names a credential and the ignore-scripts install hook, which is DEC-182 (1) floor work; a Sonnet-tier worker is expected to be above that floor, so take it only after confirming the route, and read its two acceptance criteria first (each finding fixed or declined with a reason; a mutant or fixture proving each fixed finding both ways). (2) File the plain-english-styles release task, but do NOT cut a release: measured 2026-10-27, v0.2.0 was already cut on 2026-10-26, its annotated tag object fe3dcee85f35e50b0bdb108d3b40c2c1e44fa0ea peels to commit 2a06e85f3a412e524167568d7a5bd218bd097c4c which is origin/main, dev sits one tracker-only commit above it at d1c4683f0fe92f59a86d302ecbfb693b7d01ba42, plugin.json at dev declares 0.2.0, and opum-marketplace already pins ref v0.2.0 with baselines that resolve and match. The plan number of 14 commits ahead of the last release came from the TITLE of the Done task PES-12, not from a commit count: rev-list --count v0.1.0..2a06e85f^ is 14, and all 14 are already inside v0.2.0. The only open work in that repository is COS-32 and COS-33, both To Do and unbuilt, so a real release waits on those. (3) File the negentropy-skills release task, but that repository is private, untagged, in no marketplace and outside the declared roots of this worker, and the leader has HELD it and routed it to opum-doc. Do not touch it; ask the leader to release the hold and state the delivery path first.

ENVIRONMENT LESSONS carried forward. DEC-226 floor rule: release and publish paths, pins (marketplace.json, scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json, any pinned tag bytes), CI or eval gate policy, and review of those are stop-and-report rather than work to execute, while OPAG-1467 is open; it was still status To Do when checked 2026-10-27 through a bare gh api call on opum-agent .quest/tasks/OPAG-1467.json. A second consecutive run of scripts/check-federated-content.mjs goes red with HTTP 403 on five entries, because the unauthenticated GitHub quota is 60 per hour and one full run spends about 27: read curl -s https://api.github.com/rate_limit before reporting content drift, then re-resolve the entry through authenticated bare gh api hops instead of waiting an hour. The DEC-158 ownership guard refuses shell-built paths, sed -i, and any git command carrying GIT_ environment text; use literal paths, the Edit tool, and copy-then-cmp for mutation proofs. git -C works inside plain-english-styles, a declared root, but not inside the review worktrees. All 8 registered worktrees under .claude/worktrees stay (DEC-208): do not remove, prune or deregister any of them. Spell quest actor flags out in full on every write, because zsh passes a hoisted string as one word; avoid apostrophes in single-quoted JSON, because they are silently dropped; avoid backticks in double-quoted shell text, because they execute; and read the record back after every tracker write.

SKILLS for the successor: opum-workflow:opum-sdlc for the task to branch to pull request to promotion lifecycle, opum-workflow:opum-handoff to restore, and lore plus quest for tracker and docs work. Reply to the leader by the bare name team-lead, writing PR numbers as opum-ai/opum-marketplace#N in anything that leaves this repository.
